lines: Come on, come on, what's wrong!? There's nowhere left to escape!!
It seems you don't even have the strength to distort dimensions anymore!
The two had cut down the "guard dogs" and only the octopus, the Brain Flayer, was left to kill.
Sakura-sensei's shadow blades flew at the Brain Flayer all at once.
However, the blades were all repelled an invisible barrier.
≪It's a shield I fashioned by compressing a dimension!! B-Breaking it with such an unscientific blade won't be possible, you lower lifeform!!!≫
Apparently there was an invisible shield in front of him. It was deflecting shadow blades, kunai, and everything else.
Rinko-senpai drew her favorite sword, "Ishikiri Kanemitsu," and held it calmly, a cold glint in her eyes.
≪Kuhahahaha! What are you planning, you lower lifeform?! There's no way you can break through my shield with such a primitive weapon!!≫
If they are told that something is impossible to cut, a Taimanin will naturally want to try it.
"Qi" was suddenly swelling up around Rinko-senpai's bodyー
A single flash of light could be seen.
The Brain Flayer's body slid apart at the waist.
The upper half of his body slid off and fell to the ground, and the lower half also collapsed while spraying blood everywhere.
(Amazing...!! So this the true power of the "Slasher Taimanin.")
She was an Air Jutsu user and was also the heir to the Ace Katana Style school of swordsmanship.
Her swordsmanship combined with her Air Jutsu allowed for her Ultimate Skill: Severing Butterfliesー
(I would love for her to join my squad somehow...)
Sakura-sensei, who was still a student in this world, seemed to be amazed by Rinko-senpai's skills.
Yeah, I wouldn't want to make an enemy of Rinko-senpai...
Hehehe♪ Wasn't she your older sister?
Crap. I had forgotten our backstory.
Ah, I-I mean isn't Rinko nee-chan amazing?!
Ahaha! No need to pretend anymore! You're not her little brother, right?
Wha...!? So you noticed...! S-Since when...?
From the very beginning. I mean, everyone knows that Rinko-san came from another world.
Ehh?! I was so clear in my instructions to the young Rinko...
The young Rinko-chan of this world tried her best so that you, the big Rinko-san, could live here without worries.
Ugh... th-that girl... I mean, she's me, but...
Rinko-senpai was at her wit's end, with a complicated look on her face.
But because of this, you won't be able to go back to your world, right?
If you need a place to stay, feel free to come to my house together with Shikanosuke-kun! My older sister is kind of scary though.
Uhh... alright, I'll discuss it with Shikanosuke... Shikanosuke?
As I looked around for Shikanosuke, I found him peering at the dead body of the Brain Flayer with great fascination.
Amazing... the exact opposite of Hebiko. How does that work?
(...When it comes to things like this, he's quite brave... Maybe he's used to octopuses because of Hebiko?)
Suddenly, the Brain Flayer's upper body jumped up, quickly grabbed Shikanosuke, and put him in a wrestling hold.
≪Tooooo bad!!! I'm okay as long as my head is intact!!!≫
≪O-hoho!! Now then, let me go if you don't want this little one to die!!!!!≫
Even though he had been completely cut in half, the Brain Flayer managed to form an energy sphere and aim it at Shikanosuke.
Aieeeeeee! Help meee!! It's all hot and crackling with energy!!!
≪O-hoho!! Nothing you can do!!! I have already researched everything there is to know about lower lifeforms like you!≫
≪I even know about your absurd habit of prioritizing the lives of your friends over anything else!≫
The Brain Flayer spoke full of confidence.
Well, now we're in trouble. I can't use my sword as long as he has Uehara.
I'm also not very good at controlling my shadow blades with precision...
≪Victory!!! Victory is mine!! I'm going to bring my comrades and get my revenge on you!≫
It seemed as if he was buying time until he regained his power to warp dimensions. The Brain Flayer slowly backed up while still holding Shikanosuke.
≪Don't you know when to give up, you vermin!? What is it now!?≫
Do you think you can just get away like that?
I grabbed a dagger from Sakura-sensei and brandished it.
Hey, Shikanosuke! Sorry, but I'm going to slice through both of you!!
I know all your tendencies!!! I'll at least make it painless for you!!!
≪Wha...!!!? Impossible...!!! Lower lifeforms like you are supposed to make their friends' lives their first priority...!!!!≫
I vaulted myself forward and closed the distance at once, and then struck the dagger without hesitationー
In the next moment, the dagger was sticking out of the Brain Flayer's head.
I thought I was gonna dieeeeeeeee!!!!
With perfect timing, he had tilted his head to dodge the dagger.
The Brain Flayer let out an odd shriek, and just as his body emitted a strange light and twitched about...
...he finally turned to ashes, disappearing as if he had never existed in the first place.
Hooooo... amazing!!! That was pretty good, Fuma-kun!!!
I'm surprised... Uehara, good job avoiding Fuma's strike in that position.
I-It's because Fuma gave me a sign... Saying how he knows all my tendencies.
Shikanosuke has a tendency to dodge to the right when being attacked from the front. I practice with him quite a bit...
I see. But that can't be done without trusting each other. Great job, both of you.
Rinko-senpai gave us a friendly pat on the shoulder.
Yeah! You're pretty cool, you two!!!
Ah, there you are! What are you guys doing?
Suddenly Hebiko appeared, making a face as if nothing had happened.
Hebiko heard you guys were training, but you weren't there in the gym!
The sudden appearance of something familiar left me and Shikanosuke speechless for a moment.
Well, if Hebiko is here... does that mean that we are back to our normal world?
Come to think of it, we moved from dimension to dimension several times... Does that mean we had already come back at some point...?
It seemed like we had returned to the original Gosha Academy without noticing.
Oh man, I was prepared to not be able to return, but... we are saved! Thanks to Mr. Brain Flayer here.
However, it felt like I was forgetting something.
Hey, hey, did something happen? Oh, Sakura-sensei, you look particularly young today!!
In contrast to Hebiko's cheerful voice, the rest of us fell completely silent.
